assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and persistent dizziness that have significantly impacted daily activities.
To evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of these symptoms, a 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiogram is ordered to capture cardiac rhythm during symptomatic periods.
A 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiogram is performed, coded as CPT 93226.
The claim for the 48-hour Holter monitoring study, CPT code 93226, was denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code PR-204.
The service is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan.
No payment will be issued for this specific procedure.
The patient has the right to appeal this determination.
